# pii-detector-fr - LLM Context Pack

## Snapshot
- Name: pii-detector-fr
- Maintainer: Exahia
- Type: Open-source Python package + CLI
- License: MIT
- Scope: Detect/anonymize French PII before sending text to LLM systems.

## Supported Entity Types (current baseline)
- EMAIL
- PHONE_NUMBER (French formats)
- ADDRESS_FR (French postal addresses)
- IBAN (French IBAN validation)
- NIR
- SIREN / SIRET
- CREDIT_CARD (Luhn-validated)
- LICENSE_PLATE_FR
- DATE (dd/mm/yyyy)

## Core Files
- Detector logic: `pii_detector/detector.py`
- CLI: `pii_detector/__main__.py`
- Tests: `tests/test_detector.py`
- Package metadata: `pyproject.toml`

## Typical Use Cases
- Redact sensitive data before prompt submission.
- Add deterministic pseudonymization in logging pipelines.
- Integrate in pre-processing middleware for enterprise AI systems.

## Limits
- Regex-first baseline, no statistical confidence model.
- Project-specific validation remains required for production usage.
